import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
#check_failure Roth.normOne
namespace NormOneRaw
variable {σ : Type*}
noncomputable def replacement (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) : ℝ :=
  P.coeff.sum (fun _ z ↦ |(z : ℝ)|)
theorem nonneg (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) : 0 ≤ replacement P :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _
theorem zero : replacement (0 : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) = 0 := by
  simp [replacement]
theorem coefficientBound (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ replacement P :=
  Finsupp.single_eval_le_sum P.coeff (g := fun z ↦ |(z : ℝ)|) (by simp)
    (fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _) d
theorem supportBound (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ d, |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ B) :
    replacement P ≤ P.support.card * B := by
  simpa [replacement, Finsupp.sum] using
    P.support.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ (fun d _ ↦ hB d)
#print axioms replacement
#print axioms nonneg
#print axioms zero
#print axioms coefficientBound
#print axioms supportBound
#check @Finsupp.sum
end NormOneRaw
